name: RRSOS PCC Boosters
description: A Boosters screen in the build menu (1 Iron, 1 Aluminium, 1 Alloy). Using it opens a window where you pick a named beacon, a booster (heat, pressure, power, butterflies, bees, ecosystem, frog, tree, grass, flower), the machine tier, an optimizer (none, T1, T2; one per fuse of the booster, optionally pre-filled) and what to fill the machines with; Build places eight machines (stacked, or in a ring around the optimizers) at the beacon for free and takes the beacon away.
